Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.

commands.description: Provides a prompt to generate design system rules for this repo.

content.content:
1	# F-02 Sort by savings

# F-02 Sort by savings

Goal: a new sort option "Biggest savings" that puts the products
with the largest absolute saving (in money, not percent) first.
Why: "Biggest discount" sorts by percent; a 50 % cap saves less than
a 25 % jacket.

Decisions:

- New SortKey 'savings', label "Biggest savings", in src/lib/catalogQuery.ts.
- Saving of a product = max over AVAILABLE variants of
  (compareAtCents - priceCents), only where compareAtCents > priceCents.
- Currencies are compared by raw cents (known limitation).

Acceptance criteria (tests: src/acceptance/F-02-sort-by-savings.test.ts):

- AC-1: SORT_LABELS.savings is "Biggest savings".
- AC-2: jacket 200 -> 150 (saves 5000) comes before cap 20 -> 10 (saves 1000).
- AC-3: products without saving come last.
- AC-4: savings of unavailable variants do not count.
- AC-5: equal savings are ordered by title A-Z.

Out of scope: UI changes beyond the new option in the sort menu.

1	import { foldText } from './normalize'
2	import type { Category, Product } from './types'
3	
4	export type SortKey = 'featured' | 'newest' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'discount' | 'title'
5	
6	export const SORT_LABELS: Record<SortKey, string> = {
7	  featured: 'Featured',
8	  newest: 'Newest',
9	  'price-asc': 'Price: low to high',
10	  'price-desc': 'Price: high to low',
11	  discount: 'Biggest discount',
12	  title: 'Name A–Z',
13	}
14	
15	export interface CatalogFilters {
16	  query: string
17	  stores: string[]
18	  categories: Category[]
19	  /** Whole currency units, as typed by the user. */
20	  minPrice: number | null
21	  maxPrice: number | null
22	  isInStockOnly: boolean
23	  isOnSaleOnly: boolean
24	  sort: SortKey
25	}
26	
27	export const DEFAULT_FILTERS: CatalogFilters = {
28	  query: '',
29	  stores: [],
30	  categories: [],
31	  minPrice: null,
32	  maxPrice: null,
33	  isInStockOnly: false,
34	  isOnSaleOnly: false,
35	  sort: 'featured',
36	}
37	
38	export function countActiveFilters(f: CatalogFilters): number {
39	  return (
40	    f.stores.length +
41	    f.categories.length +
42	    (f.minPrice !== null ? 1 : 0) +
43	    (f.maxPrice !== null ? 1 : 0) +
44	    (f.isInStockOnly ? 1 : 0) +
45	    (f.isOnSaleOnly ? 1 : 0)
46	  )
47	}
48	
49	/**
50	 * Interleaves stores round-robin so the default view shows a mix of merchants
51	 * instead of one store's entire catalog followed by the next.
52	 */
53	export function interleaveByStore(products: Product[]): Product[] {
54	  const buckets = new Map<string, Product[]>()
55	  for (const p of products) {
56	    const list = buckets.get(p.storeDomain)
57	    if (list) list.push(p)
58	    else buckets.set(p.storeDomain, [p])
59	  }
60	  const lists = [...buckets.values()]
61	  const out: Product[] = []
62	  for (let i = 0; out.length < products.length; i++) {
63	    for (const list of lists) if (i < list.length) out.push(list[i]!)
64	  }
65	  return out
66	}
67	
68	type Facet = 'stores' | 'categories' | null
69	
70	function matches(p: Product, f: CatalogFilters, tokens: string[], skip: Facet): boolean {
71	  if (skip !== 'stores' && f.stores.length && !f.stores.includes(p.storeDomain)) return false
72	  if (skip !== 'categories' && f.categories.length && !f.categories.includes(p.category)) return false
73	  if (f.isInStockOnly && !p.isAvailable) return false
74	  if (f.isOnSaleOnly && p.maxDiscountPct <= 0) return false
75	  // A product matches a price range if any of its variants could.
76	  if (f.minPrice !== null && p.maxPriceCents < f.minPrice * 100) return false
77	  if (f.maxPrice !== null && p.minPriceCents > f.maxPrice * 100) return false
78	  for (const t of tokens) if (!p.searchText.includes(t)) return false
79	  return true
80	}
81	
82	export function tokenize(query: string): string[] {
83	  return foldText(query).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
84	}
85	
86	/** Products are expected in "featured" order (see interleaveByStore). */
87	export function queryCatalog(products: Product[], f: CatalogFilters): Product[] {
88	  const tokens = tokenize(f.query)
89	  const result = products.filter((p) => matches(p, f, tokens, null))
90	  // Push sold-out items to the end without otherwise disturbing the chosen order.
91	  const byAvailability = (a: Product, b: Product) => Number(b.isAvailable) - Number(a.isAvailable)
92	  switch (f.sort) {
93	    case 'newest':
94	      return result.sort((a, b) => b.publishedAt - a.publishedAt)
95	    case 'price-asc':
96	      return result.sort((a, b) => byAvailability(a, b) || a.minPriceCents - b.minPriceCents)
97	    case 'price-desc':
98	      return result.sort((a, b) => byAvailability(a, b) || b.minPriceCents - a.minPriceCents)
99	    case 'discount':
100	      return result.sort((a, b) => b.maxDiscountPct - a.maxDiscountPct || byAvailability(a, b))
101	    case 'title':
102	      return result.sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title))
103	    case 'featured':
104	      return result.sort(byAvailability)
105	  }
106	}
107	
108	/** Counts per facet value, computed as if that facet weren't applied (standard faceted search). */
109	export function facetCounts(products: Product[], f: CatalogFilters) {
110	  const tokens = tokenize(f.query)
111	  const stores: Record<string, number> = {}
112	  const categories: Partial<Record<Category, number>> = {}
113	  for (const p of products) {
114	    if (matches(p, f, tokens, 'stores')) stores[p.storeDomain] = (stores[p.storeDomain] ?? 0) + 1
115	    if (matches(p, f, tokens, 'categories')) categories[p.category] = (categories[p.category] ?? 0) + 1
116	  }
117	  return { stores, categories }
118	}

1	import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
2	import { DEFAULT_FILTERS, queryCatalog, SORT_LABELS } from '../lib/catalogQuery'
3	import { normalizeProduct } from '../lib/normalize'
4	import { rawProduct, store } from '../lib/testFixtures'
5	import type { Product } from '../lib/types'
6	
7	function product(id: number, title: string, price: string, compareAt: string | null, available = true): Product {
8	  return normalizeProduct(
9	    rawProduct({
10	      id, title, handle: `p-${id}`,
11	      options: [{ name: 'Title', values: ['Default Title'] }],
12	      variants: [{ id: id * 10, title: 'Default Title', option1: 'Default Title', option2: null,
13	        option3: null, price, compare_at_price: compareAt, available }],
14	    }),
15	    store,
16	  )!
17	}
18	
19	const bySavings = (products: Product[]) =>
20	  queryCatalog(products, { ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, sort: 'savings' as never }).map((p) => p.id)
21	
22	describe('F-02 sort by savings', () => {
23	  it('AC-1: offers "Biggest savings"', () => {
24	    expect((SORT_LABELS as Record<string, string>).savings).toBe('Biggest savings')
25	  })
26	  it('AC-2: absolute saving, not percent', () => {
27	    const cap = product(2, 'Cap', '10.00', '20.00')         // 50 %, saves 1000
28	    const jacket = product(1, 'Jacket', '150.00', '200.00') // 25 %, saves 5000
29	    expect(bySavings([cap, jacket])).toEqual([1, 2])
30	  })
31	  it('AC-3: products without saving come last', () => {
32	    expect(bySavings([product(3, 'Sock', '5.00', null), product(4, 'Tee', '20.00', '25.00')])).toEqual([4, 3])
33	  })
34	  it('AC-4: unavailable variants do not count', () => {
35	    expect(bySavings([product(5, 'Boot', '50.00', '100.00', false), product(6, 'Belt', '30.00', '35.00')])).toEqual([6, 5])
36	  })
37	  it('AC-5: equal savings ordered by title', () => {
38	    expect(bySavings([product(7, 'Zebra', '10.00', '20.00'), product(8, 'Apple', '10.00', '20.00')])).toEqual([8, 7])
39	  })
40	})
